_comment: Site presets used by `php artisan thingsboard:setup` and `php artisan licor:setup` to create or link sites on a fresh installation. This is deployment data, not code: edit it, or pass another file with --presets=path. Nothing here is needed once a site exists; everything can also be set per site in Admin > Sites > Edit, and new sources can be linked from Admin > Data sources. Source: the partners' 'Sensor Set Up and Parameters' document (The Gambia). 'match' finds an existing site whose name contains it.
